value.rationale: The result identifies the exact global total-variation robustness of naturally diagonally quadratic Fenchel–Young prediction; proves every worst-case perturbation can be realized within the smooth full-support regime; characterizes all fixed-total best and limiting configurations; and establishes weak NP-completeness of the exact sharp sensitivity despite easy individual prediction.
